bad: I see two babys in the park.
I see two baby in the park.
I see two babyes in the park.

cz.st: I see two ___ in the park.

items.rule: 〈자음+y〉로 끝나는 낱말은 y를 i로 바꾸고 -es를 붙여요.

items.good: Three children are playing in the yard.
items.ko: 아이들 세 명이 마당에서 놀고 있어요.
bad: Three childs are playing in the yard.
Three children is playing in the yard.
Three childrens are playing in the yard.

cz.st: Three ___ are playing in the yard.

items.rule: child의 복수형은 불규칙하게 children이에요. children은 이미 복수라서 -s를 또 붙이지 않아요.

items.good: My feet are cold.
bad: My foots are cold.
My feet is cold.
My feets are cold.

cz.st: My ___ are cold.

items.rule: foot의 복수형은 불규칙하게 feet이고, 복수 주어 뒤에는 are를 써요.

items.good: There is a library near my school.
items.ko: 우리 학교 근처에 도서관이 하나 있어요.
bad: There are a library near my school.
There is library a near my school.
There a library is near my school.

cz.st: There ___ a library near my school.

items.rule: 하나(단수)가 있을 때는 There is를 써요.

items.good: There are many birds in the tree.
bad: There is many birds in the tree.
There are many bird in the tree.
There many birds are in the tree.

cz.st: There ___ many birds in the tree.

items.rule: 여러 개(복수)가 있을 때는 There are를 쓰고, many 뒤에는 복수 명사가 와요.

items.good: Is there a bank near here?
bad: Are there a bank near here?
There is a bank near here?
Is there bank near here?

cz.st: ___ there a bank near here?

items.rule: There is의 의문문은 Is there ~?로 is를 앞으로 보내요. 하나일 때는 Is, 여러 개일 때는 Are를 써요.

items.good: Are there any apples in the basket?
bad: Is there any apples in the basket?
Are there any apple in the basket?
Are there apples any in the basket?

cz.st: Are there ___ apples in the basket?

items.rule: 의문문에서 '조금도, 좀'이라는 뜻으로는 any를 쓰고, 뒤에는 복수 명사가 와요.

items.good: There isn't a cloud in the sky.
bad: There aren't a cloud in the sky.
There not is a cloud in the sky.
There isn't clouds in the sky.

cz.st: There ___ a cloud in the sky.

items.rule: 하나가 없다고 할 때는 There isn't를 써요. 여러 개가 없을 때는 There aren't를 써요.

items.good: There aren't any chairs in the room.
bad: There isn't any chairs in the room.
There aren't any chair in the room.
There aren't a chairs in the room.

cz.st: There aren't ___ chairs in the room.

items.rule: 부정문에서 '하나도'라는 뜻으로는 any를 쓰고, 뒤에는 복수 명사가 와요.

items.good: The sun rises in the east.
bad: Sun rises in the east.
The sun rises in east.
A sun rises in the east.

cz.st: ___ sun rises in the east.

items.rule: 세상에 하나뿐인 것(the sun, the moon)에는 the를 붙이고, 방향 east 앞에도 the를 써요.

items.good: My mother is a teacher.
bad: My mother is teacher.
My mother is an teacher.
My mother a teacher is.

cz.st: My mother is ___ teacher.

items.rule: 직업을 말할 때 셀 수 있는 단수 명사 앞에는 a/an을 붙여요. teacher는 자음 소리로 시작해서 a를 써요.

items.good: It is an old bike.
bad: It is a old bike.
It is old a bike.
It an is old bike.

cz.st: It is an ___ bike.

items.rule: a와 an은 바로 뒤에 오는 낱말의 소리로 정해요. old는 모음 소리로 시작해서 an old가 돼요.

items.good: There is some milk in the glass.
bad: There are some milk in the glass.
There is some milks in the glass.
There is two milk in the glass.

cz.st: There is some ___ in the glass.

items.rule: milk처럼 셀 수 없는 명사는 복수형으로 쓰지 않고 There is와 함께 써요.

items.good: I have two watches.
bad: I have two watchs.
I have two watch.
I have two watchies.

cz.st: I have two ___.

items.rule: ch로 끝나는 낱말은 -es를 붙여 복수형을 만들어요.

items.good: Two leaves fell from the tree.
bad: Two leafs fell from the tree.
Two leaf fell from the tree.
Two leaves falls from the tree.

cz.st: Two ___ fell from the tree.

items.rule: leaf처럼 f로 끝나는 일부 낱말은 f를 v로 바꾸고 -es를 붙여 leaves가 돼요.

items.good: Two men are fixing the roof.
items.ko: 남자 두 명이 지붕을 고치고 있어요.
bad: Two mans are fixing the roof.
Two men is fixing the roof.
Two man are fixing the roof.

cz.st: Two ___ are fixing the roof.

items.rule: man의 복수형은 불규칙하게 men이에요.

items.good: Five sheep are in the field.
bad: Five sheeps are in the field.
Five sheep is in the field.
Five of sheep are in the field.

cz.st: Five ___ are in the field.

items.good: How many books are there on the desk?

bad: How many book are there on the desk?
How many books is there on the desk?
How many books there are on the desk?

cz.st: How many ___ are there on the desk?

items.rule: How many 뒤에는 셀 수 있는 복수 명사가 와요.

items.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 말은?
___ umbrella is on the chair.
items.why: umbrella는 모음 소리로 시작하고 하나뿐이라서 An을 써요.

items.q: 다음 중 앞에 a를 붙이는 낱말은?
items.why: uniform은 '유' 소리로 시작해서 a uniform이에요. 나머지는 모음 소리로 시작하는 an orange, an ear, an hour예요.

items.q: 다음 중 앞에 an을 붙이는 낱말은?
items.why: hour는 h가 소리 나지 않아서 an hour예요. 나머지는 a house, a horse, a hat이에요.

items.q: baby의 복수형은?
items.why: 〈자음+y〉로 끝나는 낱말은 y를 i로 바꾸고 -es를 붙여요.

items.q: bus의 복수형은?
items.why: s로 끝나는 낱말은 -es를 붙여 buses가 돼요.

items.q: woman의 복수형은?
items.why: woman의 복수형은 불규칙하게 women이에요.

items.q: tooth의 복수형은?
items.why: tooth의 복수형은 불규칙하게 teeth예요.

items.q: 다음 중 복수형이 단수형과 같은 낱말은?
items.why: sheep은 단수와 복수가 같아요. 나머지는 cows, goats, hens로 -s를 붙여요.

items.q: 다음 중 복수형이 잘못된 것은?
items.why: woman의 복수형은 women이므로 womans가 틀렸어요.

items.q: knife의 복수형은?
items.why: f나 fe로 끝나는 일부 낱말은 v로 바꾸고 -es를 붙여요. knife는 knives가 돼요.

items.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 말은?
There ___ two cats under the table.
items.why: 고양이가 둘(복수)이라서 There are를 써요.

items.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 말은?
There ___ some water in the bottle.
items.why: water는 셀 수 없는 명사라서 There is를 써요.

items.q: '책상 위에 연필 세 자루가 있어요.'를 영어로 바르게 쓴 것은?
o: There is three pencils on the desk.
There are three pencils on the desk.

There three pencils are on the desk.
items.why: 세 자루(복수)이므로 There are를 쓰고 명사에는 -s를 붙여요.

items.q: '방에 의자가 하나 있어요.'를 영어로 바르게 쓴 것은?
o: There is a chair in the room.
There are a chair in the room.
There is chair a in the room.
There a chair is in the room.
items.why: 하나일 때는 There is a ~.로 말해요.

items.q: '공원에 아이들이 많이 있어요.'를 영어로 바르게 쓴 것은?
o: There is many children in the park.
There are many childs in the park.
There many children are in the park.
There are many children in the park.
items.why: children은 복수이고 There are와 함께 써요. child의 복수형은 children이에요.

items.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 말은?
Is there ___ egg in the fridge?
items.why: egg는 모음 소리로 시작하고 하나를 묻는 문장이라서 an을 써요.

items.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 말은?
My brother has ___ new bike.
items.why: new는 자음 소리로 시작하는 단수 명사 bike 앞에서 a와 함께 써요.

items.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 말은?
Look at ___ stars! They are bright.
items.why: 눈앞에 보이는 특정한 별들을 가리키므로 the를 써요. stars가 복수라서 a, an, one은 쓸 수 없어요.

items.q: 다음 중 셀 수 없는 명사는?
items.why: water는 하나, 둘로 셀 수 없는 명사예요.

items.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 말은?
How many ___ do you have?
items.why: How many 뒤에는 셀 수 있는 복수 명사가 와요. milk와 water는 셀 수 없어요.

items.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 말은?
I have ___ sister and two brothers.
items.why: sister가 하나이고 자음 소리로 시작하므로 a를 써요.

items.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 말은?
___ there any milk in the cup?
items.why: milk는 셀 수 없는 명사라서 Is there ~?로 물어요.

items.q: 다음 중 복수형을 만들 때 -es를 붙이는 낱말은?
items.why: sh로 끝나는 낱말은 -es를 붙여 dishes가 돼요.

items.q: 다음 중 복수형이 -ies로 끝나는 낱말은?
items.why: story는 y를 i로 바꾸고 -es를 붙여 stories가 돼요. toy, boy, day는 모음+y라서 -s만 붙여요.

items.q:
A: What is in the box?
B: ___ two balls.
items.why: 공이 두 개(복수)라서 There are를 써요.

items.q: '오렌지 주스 한 잔'을 영어로 바르게 쓴 것은?
items.why: glass는 자음 소리로 시작해서 a를 쓰고, 〈a glass of ~〉의 순서로 말해요.

items.title: My Room
items.text: My room is small, but I like it. There is a bed next to the window. There are two shelves on the wall, and there are many books on them. On my desk, there is a lamp and an eraser. Under the bed, there are three boxes. They have my old toys inside. I clean my room every Sunday.

qs.q: What is the passage mainly about?
o: A trip to a toy shop
A day of cleaning with friends
The writer's room and things in it
qs.why: 글쓴이의 방과 그 안에 있는 물건들을 소개하는 글이에요.

qs.q: Where is the bed?
qs.why: There is a bed next to the window.라고 했어요.

qs.q: How many boxes are under the bed?
qs.why: Under the bed, there are three boxes.라고 했어요.

qs.q: What is on the desk?
qs.why: On my desk, there is a lamp and an eraser.라고 했어요.

qs.q: When does the writer clean the room?
qs.why: I clean my room every Sunday.라고 했어요.

items.title: A Day at the Zoo
items.text: Last Saturday, my class went to the zoo. We saw an elephant first. It was very big, and it ate a lot of grass. Then we saw two monkeys in a tree. They were funny. There were many children near the lions, so we waited. At lunch, I ate an egg sandwich on a bench.

qs.q: What did the class see first?
qs.why: We saw an elephant first.라고 했어요.

qs.q: How many monkeys did they see?
qs.why: two monkeys라고 했어요.

qs.q: Why did the class wait near the lions?
qs.why: There were many children near the lions, so we waited.에서 이유를 알 수 있어요.

qs.q: What does "They" mean in "They were funny"?
qs.why: 바로 앞 문장의 two monkeys를 가리켜요.

qs.q: What did the writer eat at lunch?
qs.why: I ate an egg sandwich on a bench.라고 했어요.

items.title: A Message from Hana
items.text: Hi Jun, I am having a picnic on Saturday. It is at Green Park. There is a big lake, and there are many trees, so it is a nice place. Please bring a sandwich and some juice. I have two balls, so we can play soccer. Please come at ten. Your friend, Hana

qs.q: Why did Hana write this message?
o: To ask for a soccer ball
To tell Jun about a lake
To invite Jun to a picnic
qs.why: 피크닉에 초대하려는 글이에요.

qs.q: Where is the picnic?
qs.why: It is at Green Park.라고 했어요.

qs.q: What should Jun bring?
o: A soccer ball and some chairs
Some paper and a few pens
A big towel and a blanket
qs.why: Please bring a sandwich and some juice.라고 했어요.

qs.q: What can they do with Hana's balls?
qs.why: I have two balls, so we can play soccer.라고 했어요.

qs.q: Why does Hana say Green Park is a nice place?
o: It has a shop and a zoo
It has a lake and many trees
qs.why: There is a big lake, and there are many trees라고 했어요.

items.title: Mr. Kim's Farm
items.text: Mr. Kim has a small farm. There are five sheep, three cows and ten chickens on his farm. Every morning, he gives the cows some grass. The chickens give him eggs, and the sheep give him wool. In the evening, children from the town visit the farm. They love the baby sheep.

qs.q: What is the passage mainly about?
qs.why: Mr. Kim의 작은 농장에 대한 글이에요.

qs.q: How many cows are on the farm?
qs.why: three cows라고 했어요.

qs.q: What do the chickens give Mr. Kim?
qs.why: The chickens give him eggs라고 했어요.

qs.q: When do the children visit the farm?
qs.why: In the evening, children from the town visit the farm.이라고 했어요.

qs.q: Which sentence is true?
o: Mr. Kim has a very big farm
The cows give him wool and eggs
There are more chickens than sheep
The children do not like the sheep
qs.why: 닭은 열 마리, 양은 다섯 마리라서 닭이 더 많아요.

items.good: This book is more interesting than that one.

bad: This book is interestinger than that one.
This book is most interesting than that one.
This book is interesting than that one.

items.good: English is more difficult than math for me.

items.rule: 긴 형용사의 최상급은 the most를 앞에 붙여요.

items.good: Summer is hotter than spring.
bad: Summer is hoter than spring.
Summer is more hot than spring.
Summer is hottest than spring.

cz.st: Summer is ___ than spring.

items.rule: hot처럼 〈짧은 모음+자음〉으로 끝나는 낱말은 t를 한 번 더 쓰고 -er을 붙여요.

items.good: Ben runs faster than Jin.
bad: Ben runs fast than Jin.
Ben runs more fast than Jin.
Ben runs fastest than Jin.

cz.st: Ben runs ___ than Jin.

items.rule: fast는 형용사와 부사의 모양이 같고, 비교급은 faster예요.

items.good: I have more books than my sister.
bad: I have many books than my sister.
I have more book than my sister.
I have mores books than my sister.

cz.st: I have ___ books than my sister.

items.rule: many의 비교급은 more이고, more 뒤에 than으로 비교 대상을 써요.

items.good: Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world.
bad: Mount Everest is the higher mountain in the world.
Mount Everest is the most high mountain in the world.
Mount Everest is highest mountain in the world.

cz.st: Mount Everest is the ___ mountain in the world.

items.rule: 세계에서 가장 ~한 것은 the + -est로 나타내요.

items.good: A car is much faster than a bike.
bad: A car is very faster than a bike.
A car is much fast than a bike.
A car is faster much than a bike.

cz.st: A car is ___ faster than a bike.

items.rule: 비교급을 강조해서 '훨씬'이라고 할 때는 much를 써요. very는 비교급 앞에 쓰지 않아요.

items.good: The blue shirt is cheaper than the red one.
items.ko: 파란 셔츠는 빨간 셔츠보다 더 싸요.
bad: The blue shirt is cheapest than the red one.
The blue shirt is more cheap than the red one.
The blue shirt is cheaper as the red one.

cz.st: The blue shirt is cheaper ___ the red one.

items.rule: 비교하는 대상 앞에는 than을 써요. then은 '그때'라는 뜻의 다른 낱말이에요.

items.good: Winter is the coldest season in Korea.
bad: Winter is the colder season in Korea.
Winter is coldest the season in Korea.
Winter is the most cold season in Korea.

cz.st: Winter is the ___ season in Korea.

items.rule: 네 계절 중에서 가장 ~한 것이므로 최상급 the coldest를 써요.

items.q: tall의 비교급은?
items.why: 짧은 형용사는 -er을 붙여 taller가 돼요.

items.q: big의 최상급은?
items.why: big은 g를 한 번 더 쓰고 -est를 붙여 biggest가 돼요.

items.q: happy의 비교급은?
items.why: 〈자음+y〉로 끝나는 낱말은 y를 i로 바꾸고 -er을 붙여요.

items.q: good의 비교급은?
items.why: good의 비교급은 불규칙하게 better예요.

items.q: bad의 최상급은?
items.why: bad-worse-worst로 불규칙하게 변해요.

items.q: beautiful의 비교급은?
items.why: 긴 형용사는 앞에 more를 붙여 비교급을 만들어요.

items.q: 다음 중 more를 붙여 비교급을 만드는 낱말은?
items.why: expensive는 긴 낱말이라서 more expensive가 돼요. 나머지는 colder, faster, longer예요.

items.q: 다음 중 -er을 붙여 비교급을 만드는 낱말은?
items.why: quick은 짧은 낱말이라서 quicker가 돼요. 나머지는 more famous, more popular, more difficult예요.

items.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 말은?
A giraffe is ___ than a horse.
items.why: 둘을 비교하고 뒤에 than이 있으므로 비교급 taller를 써요.

items.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 말은?
This is the ___ day of my life. (가장 행복한)
items.why: the 뒤에는 최상급이 오고, happy는 y를 i로 바꾸어 happiest가 돼요.

items.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 말은?
Today is ___ than yesterday. (더 따뜻한)
items.why: than 앞에는 비교급을 써요. warm은 짧은 낱말이라서 warmer가 돼요.

items.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 말은?
Math is ___ than science for me. (더 쉬운)
items.why: easy는 y를 i로 바꾸고 -er을 붙여 easier가 돼요.

items.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 말은?
Who runs the ___ in your class?
items.why: 반 전체 중에서 가장 빠르므로 the fastest를 써요.

items.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 말은?
This bag is as ___ as that bag.
items.why: as ~ as 사이에는 원래 형태의 형용사를 써요.

items.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 말은?
My cat is smaller ___ your cat.
items.why: 비교급 뒤에서 비교 대상을 이끄는 말은 than이에요.

items.q: 'He is older than me.'의 뜻으로 알맞은 것은?
items.why: older than은 '~보다 나이가 많은'이라는 뜻이에요.

items.q: 'Sora is the shortest in her family.'의 뜻으로 알맞은 것은?
o: 소라는 가족 중에서 키가 가장 커요.
소라는 가족 중에서 키가 가장 작아요.
items.why: the shortest는 '가장 키가 작은'이라는 뜻이에요.

items.q: heavier의 반대말은?
items.why: 무거운(heavy)의 반대는 가벼운(light)이라서 heavier의 반대는 lighter예요.

items.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 말은?
She is the ___ student in our school. (가장 똑똑한)
items.why: 학교 전체에서 가장 똑똑하므로 the smartest를 써요.

items.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 말은?
Which is ___, the red car or the blue car? (더 비싼)
items.why: 둘을 비교하는 질문이고 expensive는 긴 낱말이라서 more expensive를 써요.

items.q: '이 가방이 저 가방보다 더 싸요.'를 영어로 바르게 쓴 것은?
o: This bag is cheapest than that bag.
This bag is more cheaper than that bag.
This bag is cheap than that bag.
This bag is cheaper than that bag.
items.why: 비교급 cheaper 뒤에 than을 써요. more와 -er을 함께 쓰지 않아요.

items.q: '그녀는 반에서 노래를 가장 잘해요.'를 영어로 바르게 쓴 것은?
o: She sings the goodest in her class.
She sings the better in her class.
She sings the best in her class.
She sings best than her class.
items.why: good/well의 최상급은 best예요.

items.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 말은?
A whale is ___ bigger than a fish. (훨씬)
items.why: 비교급을 강조할 때는 much를 써요. very, so, too는 비교급 앞에 쓰지 않아요.

items.q: good - better - ___
items.why: good의 최상급은 best예요.

items.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 말은?
The Pacific Ocean is the ___ ocean in the world.
items.why: 세계에서 가장 큰 것이므로 최상급 the largest를 써요.

items.q: 다음 중 비교하는 표현이 쓰이지 않은 문장은?
o: It is more useful than that.
items.why: This soup is hot.에는 비교급이나 최상급이 없어요.

items.title: Two Brothers
items.text: Jun and Min are brothers. Jun is twelve, and Min is ten, so Jun is older than Min. But Min is taller than Jun. Jun runs faster than his brother, but Min swims better. Min is the best swimmer in his class. Jun's favorite subject is math. He thinks it is more interesting than English.

qs.q: Who is older?
qs.why: Jun은 열두 살이고 Min은 열 살이에요.

qs.q: Which sentence is true about Min?
qs.why: Min swims better.라고 했어요.

qs.q: What does "it" mean in the last sentence?
qs.why: it은 바로 앞의 math를 가리켜요.

qs.q: How old is Min?
qs.why: Jun is twelve, and Min is ten이라고 했어요.

qs.q: What is the passage mainly about?
qs.why: 두 형제의 서로 다른 점을 비교한 글이에요.

items.title: Seasons in Korea
items.text: Korea has four seasons. Spring is warmer than winter, and flowers come out. Summer is the hottest season, and it is also the wettest because of the rain in July. Autumn is cooler than summer, and many people think it is the most beautiful season. Winter is the coldest, so I wear a thick coat.

qs.q: Which season is the hottest?
qs.why: Summer is the hottest season이라고 했어요.

qs.q: Why does the writer wear a thick coat?
o: It rains a lot in July
qs.why: 겨울이 가장 추워서 두꺼운 코트를 입어요.

qs.q: Which season do many people think is the most beautiful?
qs.why: many people think it is the most beautiful season에서 it은 autumn이에요.

qs.q: Why is summer the wettest season?
qs.why: because of the rain in July라고 했어요.

qs.q: Why did the writer write this text?
o: To describe the seasons in Korea
To tell a story about July
qs.why: 한국의 사계절을 비교하며 설명하는 글이에요.

items.title: Choosing a Bag
items.text: Soo went to a shop with her mother. The red bag was cheaper than the blue bag, but the blue bag was bigger. The green bag was the most expensive, but it was also the lightest. Soo wanted a big bag for her books, so she chose the blue one. Her mother said, "It is the best bag for school."

qs.q: Which bag is the cheapest?
qs.why: 빨간 가방이 파란 가방보다 싸고, 초록 가방이 가장 비싸요. 그래서 빨간 가방이 가장 싸요.

qs.q: Why did Soo choose the blue bag?
o: It was big enough for her books
It was the lightest of the three bags
It was cheaper than the red one
qs.why: Soo wanted a big bag for her books라고 했어요.

qs.q: Which bag is the lightest?
qs.why: The green bag ... was also the lightest라고 했어요.

qs.q: Who said "It is the best bag for school"?
qs.why: Her mother said라고 했어요.

qs.q: What is the passage mainly about?
qs.why: Soo가 가방을 비교하고 고르는 이야기예요.

items.title: Animals Around the World
items.text: A cheetah is faster than a lion, but a lion is stronger than a cheetah. An elephant is the biggest animal on land. It is much bigger than a horse. However, a blue whale is even bigger than an elephant. It is the largest animal in the world, and it lives in the sea. A mouse is much smaller than a cat, but it is quick.

qs.q: Which animal is the largest in the world?
qs.why: a blue whale ... is the largest animal in the world라고 했어요.

qs.q: Which sentence is true?
o: A cheetah is slower than a lion
A horse is bigger than an elephant
A lion is stronger than a cheetah
A mouse is bigger than a cat
qs.why: a lion is stronger than a cheetah라고 했어요.

qs.q: Where does a blue whale live?
qs.why: it lives in the sea라고 했어요.

qs.q: Why did the writer write this text?
qs.why: 여러 동물을 서로 비교하는 글이에요.

qs.q: What does "It" mean in "It is much bigger than a horse"?
qs.why: 바로 앞 문장의 An elephant를 가리켜요.
